characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Models in the bearer’s unit gain +1 Off.
In addition, a unit containing a Banner of Shamut adds +1 to the Combat Score of its side.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text:
The bearer’s Armour value is set to 6.
At the end of Agility Step 0, each enemy model in contact with the bearer’s model that could have allocated attacks towards it, but chose not to, suffers one hit with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks, and Unmodifiable.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Accurate, March and Shoot, Quick to Fire, Stand and Shoot

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
The bearer’s model gains +1 HP and First Strike (Grind Attack (X, Magical Attacks, Toxic Attacks)).
X is equal to the number of models in contact with the bearer’s unit’s Front Facing.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s unit may never voluntarily change its number of files.
After performing a March Move, the unit loses 1D6 HP.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The target gains an Incendiary Marker, and suffers −1 Def and −1 Off.
In addition, for as long as the target contains an Incendiary Marker it suffers an additional−1 Def and −1 Off.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Melee Attacks against the model can never wound on better than 4+.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A Charging model with this Attribute, or using a weapon with this Attribute, gains the Model Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets (X). For example, a Charging model part with Devastating Charge (+1 Strength, Poison Attacks) gains +1 Strength and Poison Attacks when it is Charging. This rule is cumulative: a model part with several instances of Devastating Charge applies all Attack Attributes and Characteristics modifiers from all of them when Charging.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Affects both Shooting and Standard Melee Attacks.
Attack Value is always 1, Strength always 5, and Armour Penetration always 10.
Automatic Hits, Melee), and Multiple Wounds (2.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Attacks against the model’s unit are all resolved against the Infernal Bastion.
In addition, as long as the unit has at least one Proper Rank, apply the following to all models in the Infernal Bastion's unit when they are shooting or casting spells:
  • May draw Line of Sight as if they were Height 5, and from any point of the Infernal Bastion’s Front Facing.
  • May measure their range from the Infernal Bastion.
  • A maximum of 20 models can shoot from the unit.
They can shoot regardless of the rank they are positioned in.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
During its First Round of Combat, any model part with First Strike, or using a weapon with First Strike, gains the Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets.
For example, a model part with First Strike (+1 Str) gains +1 Str in its First Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Divine Attacks, Flaming Attacks, and Magical Attacks)

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
The attack ignores Fortitude Saves and must reroll failed to-wound rolls against models with Flammable.
At the end of an Advance Move, a model with Flaming Attacks can attempt to set on fire a Combustible Terrain Feature within 1". If a model chooses to do so, roll a D6. If the result is equal to or higher than X, where X is the number written within brackets of the Combustible keyword of the Terrain Feature, that Terrain Feature is now Burning. The model cannot perform any other Voluntary Actions in this Player Turn.
If any attack with Flaming Attacks is directed at a model inside or on top of a Combustible Terrain Feature, roll 2D6 at the end of the phase. If both dice show a result that is equal to or higher than X, where X is the number written within brackets of the Combustible keyword of the Terrain Feature, that Terrain Feature is now Burning.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Counts as Halberd, when Engaged in Combat

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Commanding Presence (12, First Strike (Stubborn), Infernal Armour, and Insignificant).

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
The bearer can cast Flaming Swords (Pyromancy) as a Bound Spell (4+).
In addition, if the bearer’s model is of Height 1, its Charge Speed is set to 4", its Mobility is set to 6", and it gains Ghost Step.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
A model part with Grind Attack resolves these attacks at the same Initiative Step as its Close Combat Attacks. It must choose an enemy model in base contact with it. The chosen enemy model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The Range of the model’s Shooting Weapon is doubled.
Enemy units hit by the weapon suffer −1" Charge Speed and −1" Mobility, both to a minimum of 3", with Duration: One Turn.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At Initiative Step 10, a Charging model part with Impact Hits must choose an enemy model in base contact. This model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the attacking model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Give one Incendiary Marker to the unit, with Duration: Permanent.
A unit containing one or more Incendiary Markers gains Weakness (Flaming Attacks).
Remove one Incendiary Marker:
  • Immediately when the unit suffers one or more wounds (before saves are performed) from Ranged Attacks with Flaming Attacks.
  • At the end of a Round of Combat in which the unit has suffered one or more wounds (before saves are performed) from Melee Attacks with Flaming Attacks. A Character leaving a unit affected by one or more Incendiary Markers is no longer affected, unless the Character was a single model unit when it gained Incendiary Markers: in that case, the Character keeps those Incendiary Markers.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The gains Commanding Presence (6"), however, this Commanding Presence only affects models with Insignificant.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
+2 Agi.
Once per Melee Phase, during Choosing Equipment and Abilities in a combat within 6" of the wielder, you may activate the following ability:
Select a single friendly unit within 6" of the wielder (which can be the wielder itself).
The selected unit gains Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks. Duration: One Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model must buy Weapon Enchantments for two of its mundane weapons.
The Points Cost of one of the Weapon Enchantments (the cheapest if applicable) is halved, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
A single model part of the bearer’s model can reroll a single failed to-hit, to-wound, or Armour Save roll per Player Turn.
This cannot be used for Crush Attacks.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: The attack doesn’t have any special effects. However, it interacts with other rules, such as Aegis (X, against Magical Attacks). Model parts with Magical Attacks apply it also to their Special Attacks (such as Breath Attack and Impact Hits).

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains Aegis (5+, against Grind Attack, Hatred, Impact Hits, Magical Attacks, Stomp Attack), and Terror.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Accurate, Area Attack (3×5), Artillery, Flaming Attacks, March and Shoot

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: After resolving all simultaneous attacks, any unit hit by at least one attack with Oil Flasks gains an Incendiary Marker.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text: Strength always 6; Flaming Attacks, Multiple Wounds (D3, and towards Weakness (Flaming Attacks)).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During Pre-game Selections, regardless of its chosen Path of Magic, the model may exchange one of its spells for the Apprentice Spell (#1) of either Alchemy, Occultism, or Pyromancy.
In addition, it gains access to the options below:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Aegis (4+), Aegis (3+, against Flaming Attacks), suffers −3 Arm, and loses Metal Armour and Infernal Armour.
The model part gains Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks.
In addition, the model gains access to the options below:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Engineer.
In addition, it gains access to the options below:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains access to the options below:

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During the opponent’s Pre-game Selections, the opponent must choose Power or Wisdom.
  • Power: the model gains Channel (1).
  • Wisdom: immediately choose up to two units from the opponent’s Army List: the chosen units begin the game with an Incendiary Marker.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: During Choosing Equipment and Abilities, each enemy unit in contact with the wearer’s model gains an Incendiary Marker.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Chassis’s Strength is set to 6, and its Armour Penetration is set to 3.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Stomp Attack can make a Special Attack which is resolved at Agility Step 0, can only be allocated towards a Health Pool of Height 0–1, and inflicts X hits, using the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons. If more than one model part of a combined model has Stomp Attack, only a single model part (chosen by the model’s owner) can perform its Stomp Attack in each Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: When the bearer attempts to cast a Learned Spell using four or more Magic Dice, treat a single rolled ‘1’ or ‘2’ as a ‘3’.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Apply the following to the model:
  • It gains Impact Hits (1 hit), Swiftstride, Centauroid, and its Height is set to 2.
  • Its Charge Speed and Mobility are both set to 7".
  • Its base size is changed to 25×50mm.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Apply the following effects while the bearer’s unit is within range of a friendly model’s
Commanding Presence:
  • Model parts with Vassal in the bearer’s unit gain Fury.
  • The bearer’s unit must reroll failed Charge Range rolls in the Charge Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s unit, as well as every enemy unit in contact with it, gain Magic Resistance (2), which is also applied to friendly spells.
This Magic Resistance value cannot be increased.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains +1 Arm, Hard Target (1) and Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model cannot take any Army Specific Magic Items, and can never cast Curse of Nezibkesh.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Friendly units entirely with Vassal within 12" of one or more models with Vassal Governor gain +1" Mobility.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains Grind Attack (X, AP 4, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable, Zeal (towards Metal Armour)).
These hits always wound on a 4+.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The models Mobility is set to 7" and it gains Swiftstride and Volcanic Embrace.
